cases.name: dies_every_20s
cases.about: A path that dies 20 s after every link-up, for 30 minutes: adopted once, then the tunnel for good.

cases.name: dies_every_3min
cases.about: A path that dies 3 minutes after every link-up, for an hour: adopted twice, then it stays on the tunnel.

cases.name: healthy
cases.about: A clean history: the first link is adopted at link-up and nothing changes in an hour.

cases.name: five_returns_a_minute_apart
cases.about: In and out every minute on a healthy path: each return is adopted at once and the level never moves.

cases.name: held_10min_resets
cases.about: After one early death the next link waits 30 s, to the millisecond; held 10 minutes, the level is 0 again, and a death after that is not early.

cases.name: early_edge_before
cases.about: A death 1 ms before 10 minutes of adoption is early.

cases.name: early_edge_at
cases.about: A death exactly 10 minutes after adoption is not early.

cases.name: own_close_background
cases.about: A link that ends by `background` never raises the level, adopted or not, however soon.

cases.name: own_close_choice
cases.about: A link that ends by `choice` never raises the level, adopted or not, however soon.

cases.name: own_close_superseded
cases.about: A link that ends by `superseded` never raises the level, adopted or not, however soon.

cases.name: own_close_instance_ended
cases.about: A link that ends by `instance_ended` never raises the level, adopted or not, however soon.

cases.name: own_close_network_change
cases.about: A link that ends by `network_change` never raises the level, adopted or not, however soon.

cases.name: death_on_probation
cases.about: On probation an instance restart changes nothing; a loss raises the level with no adoption.

cases.name: late_check_is_no_adoption
cases.about: The wait has passed but the shell's check never ran: the link was never adopted, and its death is one on probation.

cases.name: old_link_late_close
cases.about: A newer answer replaced the link; the old link's late loss changes nothing and the new link is adopted on time.

cases.name: expiry_30min
cases.about: 30 minutes after the last early death the level is 0, to the millisecond, and the next link is adopted at once.

cases.name: wait_is_fixed_at_link_up
cases.about: The level expires while a link waits its 10 minutes: the wait it was given at link-up stands.

cases.name: relaunch_keeps_the_level
cases.about: A relaunch 5 minutes after an early death: the level is still 30 s.

cases.name: relaunch_after_expiry
cases.about: A relaunch 31 minutes after the early death: the time away counted, the level is 0.

cases.name: clock_set_back
cases.about: The wall clock is set back an hour: the expiry counts from the first read after it, with no credit for the time before.

cases.name: strict_is_used_at_once
cases.about: With the tunnel ruled out by the user a link is used at once whatever the level; its deaths still count.

cases.name: lost_across_a_background_does_not_count
cases.about: A link that was up before the last return to the foreground (a computer that slept), or that is lost while in the background, does not raise the level.

cases.name: held_is_stored_at_the_background
cases.about: A link held over 10 minutes and then closed for the background: level 0 is what a relaunch finds.

cases.name: two_instances_do_not_touch
cases.about: One instance's early death leaves the other's level alone.
